name: Yuan zhi Ge - Singing Iris
source:
The world was destroyed by mysterious entities called “Minions”. Most of the human beings died either killed by the “Minions” or the “Snowflake Infection” caused by them. One day, Jiu Jiu, the only survivor in the city of Jiangzhong, meets Lin Nan, a genius scientist from the survivor camp outside the city, and that marks the beginning of the story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界被称为“小黄人”的神秘实体摧毁了。大多数人类要么是被“小黄人”杀死，要么是被“小黄人”引起的“雪花感染”而死。有一天，江中城唯一的幸存者九九在城外遇见了幸存者营的天才科学家林南，故事由此开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315160/]Steam[/url]]
